subject: afi
title: AFI.------ACC.FT.
description: Second diagram on page 234 (T(IMP)M-32), paired with AF-POST × TRS above. This one names what affinity-insight meets when accelerated-functionalism is the working partner — the deeper structural mechanism of the 'retardation of the sensibilities' the prose names: AFI (affinity insight) crossed with ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism — the partner-axis's working acceleration). AFI sits on the left with the subject-arrow; SG (source initiation) at upper-center and APP-DT (application dictates) at upper-right sit on a line that rises from TR-INFO (trans-information), which leaves the main line below them. C-RH (composite research) sits centrally, at the junction where APP-DT leaves SG's line. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) at center-right with RT-DY (reality dynamics) below and PART (participation) and BIA (bi-aitional) on the right, a chain that leaves the main line at SPT-DY. ACC-FT sits at center-left as partner-axis. DEC (decentralization) hangs at the lower-left on a vertical from the main line; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) at the bottom-center branches from DEC's line, and DIS-C-CT (disintegration of a culture's center) branches from RT-ALGN's line.
